doc.en: Whether signature is a valid Schnorr signature by pubkey over the spending transaction.
Whether at least threshold of the aligned signatures are valid for their keys. Without a threshold, all must be valid.
Whether signature is a valid Schnorr signature by pubkey over message.
Fails the spend unless signature is valid by pubkey over message. Produces no value; use it directly inside require.
base (emulator or a constructor pubkey) tweaked by the named covenant's hash. A tapscript-only key expression inside checkSig or checkMultisig.
Whether the emulator's clock has reached timestamp, a Unix time in seconds. Independent of the transaction locktime and sequence.
Relative timelock (CSV). Wrap a literal in blocks(n) or seconds(n) to state its unit. Tapscript only.
Absolute timelock (CLTV): a block height with blocks(n), or a Unix timestamp with seconds(n). Tapscript only.
A timelock in blocks, for older or after.
A timelock in seconds, for older or after. Relative delays are multiples of 512 seconds.
SHA-256 of data.
Double SHA-256 of data.
RIPEMD-160 of the SHA-256 of data.
RIPEMD-160 of data.
SHA-1 of data. Its collision resistance is broken; use it only for legacy interoperability.
Starts a streaming SHA-256 with data and returns its context.
Adds chunk to a streaming SHA-256 context.
Adds lastChunk and returns the streaming SHA-256 digest.
Hash of data with the hash function selected at runtime by hashType; 20 or 32 bytes.
The spending transaction's signature hash for hashType.
Root of a BIP-341 tagged-hash Merkle proof. Siblings in proof are 32 bytes each and combined in sorted order. An empty leafTag takes a 32-byte leaf as already hashed.
base raised to exponent, modulo modulus.
Absolute value.
The smaller of a and b.
The larger of a and b.
Whether lower <= value < upper. Empty or reversed ranges are false.
Elliptic curve point addition P + Q.
Elliptic curve scalar multiplication scalar·P.
Pairing check over aligned G1 and G2 point arrays of 1 to 16 pairs.
Fails the spend unless Q = k·P. k is 32-byte big-endian; P and Q are compressed points.
Fails the spend unless Q = P + k·G, with P x-only and k 32-byte big-endian.
size bytes of data starting at offset.
The first count bytes of data. A negative count or one past the end fails the spend.
The last count bytes of data. A negative count or one past the end fails the spend.
a followed by b.
Script-number bytes as an int.
value as Script-number bytes padded to size bytes.
data in reverse byte order.
Length of data in bytes.
